hypotheses.justification: Neither ζ nor hζ appears in the conclusion `θ (θ (γel θ)) = γel θ`; γel θ does not depend on ζ. The proof uses hζ only to call `map_μ_eq hpM2 hHp hθ hζ`, and any primitive p-th root of unity in Qbˣ works there. Such a root can be built inside the proof. Mathlib's `AlgebraicClosure.hasEnoughRootsOfUnity` (RingTheory/RootsOfUnity/AlgebraicallyClosed.lean) gives `HasEnoughRootsOfUnity (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) p` from `NeZero (p : ℚ)`, which holds by characteristic zero and p ≠ 0 (p is prime; the file's scoped `neZero_of_fact_prime` gives NeZero p). Then `HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.exists_isPrimitiveRoot` gives z : Qb with IsPrimitiveRoot z p, and `IsPrimitiveRoot.isUnit_unit` (side condition p ≠ 0) turns it into ζ' : Qbˣ with IsPrimitiveRoot ζ' p. The rest of the proof runs unchanged with ζ' in place of ζ; the final contradiction only needs `Units.ne_zero ζ'`. There is no degenerate case: p ≥ 2, so the root always exists. Once hζ is removed, ζ is mentioned nowhere and stops being an argument too.
